{{Italic Title}} {{Infobox Object |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2 Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2 Model.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |location= [[Gerudo Town]] |uses= Learning [[Cooking]] Mechanics |comp= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|''Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2''||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring [[Object]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2|Dina|BotW}}{{Cite|Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2|Game Screen|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== ''Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2'' is the second in a series of [[Cookbook]]s written by [[Aurie Taamu]].{{Cite|This collection of Aurie Taamu's notes is so amazing! I feel like I learn something new each time I read it.|Dina|BotW}} It can be found in the room where [[Ashai]] holds her [[Cooking Class]], where it is used by the students who attend it. Unlike the [[Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 1|first]] volume in the series, ''Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2'' is located too high up for [[Link]] to read.{{Cite|It's too high up to read...|Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2|BotW}} As a result he must wait for the nightly arrival of [[Dina]], who will offer to read it for him.{{Cite|That book was written by an amazing chef, Aurie Taamu. {{Small|Just between us... He was the voe that our teacher was in love with once. Or so I hear...}} If you can't reach it, would you like me to read it for you?|Dina|BotW}} It details the best ways to [[Cooking|Cook]], the use of [[Monster Extract]], and selling meals. ''Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2'' has a light green cover that is decorated with dark green decoration. It is left open on a page showing a diagram on chopping [[Carrot]]s. ==={{TotK|-}}=== ''Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2'' is found in [[Ashai]]'s [[House]] in [[Gerudo Town]], and its contents remain unchanged. Since [[Ashai]]'s [[Cooking Class]] has been put on hiatus, she has allowed the public to access the [[Book]].{{Cite|[Cooking class?] Before the sand shroud settled in, Ashai was teaching a cooking class here. You see, you can get really far in life—and in love—if you have a solid grasp of the essentials of cooking. But she has so many students now that her other class, "Voe and You," takes up all her time. So she's opened this place up for everyone's use. The {{Color TotK|Red|cookbooks}} here are really useful too. If you're planning to do any cooking at all, you should definitely give them a read.|Nellie|TotK}} The [[Book]] sits on the floor next to [[Nellie]]. ==Transcription== {{Tabs |- | Cover | {{Transcript|Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 2}} |- | Cooking for Success? | {{Transcript|Sometimes you'll witness incredible success in your cooking adventures.

When this happens, the strength and duration of your cooked food's effects will increase well beyond normal.

Using more than the usual number of ingredients is a sure way to boost the effects of your food.

But I’ve also heard rumors that the light of the red moon can have a positive effect on your cooking as well.

I haven't checked this myself, though. I get sleepy in the evenings, so I've never even seen the red moon.}} |- | Monster Extract? | {{Transcript|{{Color BotW|Blue|Monster extract}} is an ingredient that boost the effects of any dish that it has been added to.

With just one {{Color BotW|Blue|monster extract}}, you can raise the power and duration of the effects of your dish.

However, you never really know quite how the dish will turn out.

Sometimes it will raise the effect by a lot, and other times... Well not so much.

However, I, Aurie Taamu, am not a man who relies solely on luck!}} |- | A Fortune in Food? | {{Transcript|There are many in the world who will gladly pay for the dishes a chef creates!

A cooked meal can easily sell for more than the individual components you used to make it.

And don’t forget, the more ingredients you pour into a meal, the greater the value of that meal! That's basic math!

Did I learn all this from experience? No, of course not! I learned it from a friend! A dear friend! Who was a great chef!

I can't recall his name right now, but he was a friend, to be sure!}} }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== * [[Book]] * [[Gerudo Town]] * [[Aurie Taamu]] * [[Chef Aurie Taamu, Vol. 1]] {{Ref}} {{Categories |Books, Cookbooks |objects= BotW, TotK }}
